figures.caption: Figure 1: Shared-state factorization of a federated computation. Each client applies a local encoder to its local tensor, the encoded summaries are merged into a finite-dimensional shared state, and a shared-only decoder produces the final output.

Table 1: Primitive families in the base typed tensor language. The table records the behavior of a typed primitive application when at least one input is federated. Shared-only inputs remain shared under the non-matrix primitives.
Table 2: Comparison with TensorFlow Federated. The comparison is intended only to position the mathematical contribution, not to evaluate systems.
